records.title: QSVD: Efficient Low-rank Approximation for Unified Query-Key-Value Weight Compression in Low-Precision Vision-Language Models
records.reason: QSVD reduces VLM KV-cache size and compute using joint Q/K/V low-rank approximation, rank allocation, and low-bit weight/activation quantization; abstract states resource-constrained real-time deployment.

records.title: MoBiQuant: Mixture-of-Bits Quantization for Token-Adaptive Any-Precision LLM
records.reason: MoBiQuant dynamically chooses token-sensitive quantization precision for elastic LLM inference; abstract reports memory savings and throughput gains. The official arXiv title includes “Any-Precision”, a title wording difference under the same arXiv ID.

records.title: Transcending Cost-Quality Tradeoff in Agent Serving via Session-Awareness
records.reason: Official NeurIPS abstract presents AGServe session-aware LLM agent serving with KV-cache reuse, model cascading, and a dynamic resource scheduler, directly addressing serving cost and GPU utilization.

records.title: Adamas: Hadamard Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Inference
records.reason: Adamas applies Hadamard transform, bucketization, 2-bit compact representations, and top-k selection for sparse long-context inference; abstract reports up to 4.4x self-attention and 1.5x end-to-end speedups.

records.title: Optimized Speculative Sampling for GPU Hardware Accelerators
records.reason: Primary abstract parallelizes speculative-sampling matrix work across GPU threads and reports sampling profiling-time improvement. Although experiments include ASR and summarization, the method is a plausible systems-efficiency contribution to speculative decoding/inference.

records.title: LUT Tensor Core: A Software-Hardware Co-Design for LUT-Based Low-Bit LLM Inference
records.reason: Official arXiv record describes LUT Tensor Core software/hardware co-design and compiler/instruction support for low-bit LLM inference. Its current arXiv title differs from the report wording under the same ID; the official record also links the ISCA DOI.

records.title: SharQ: Bridging Activation Sparsity and FP4 Quantization for LLM Inference
records.reason: SharQ combines input-adaptive activation sparsity with FP4 quantization and fused inference kernels; its abstract reports lower latency and higher serving throughput.

records.title: HexiSeq: Accommodating Long Context Training of LLMs over Heterogeneous Hardware
records.reason: Root-owned title-only prefilter: title explicitly concerns long-context LLM training and identifies no inference, serving, or deployment-efficiency connection. Abstract was not read.

records.title: La RoSA: Enhancing LLM Efficiency via Layerwise Rotated Sparse Activation
records.reason: La RoSA uses layerwise rotations and top-k selection to create stable LLM activation sparsity without additional recovery training; abstract reports wall-clock inference speedup.

records.title: Elastic Threshold Attention: Learned Contextual Sparsity for Long-Context Decoding
records.reason: ETA learns contextual thresholds for block-sparse long-context decoding, prunes KV cache at inference, and provides a fused Triton kernel; abstract reports up to 2.15x end-to-end speedup.

records.title: Cerberus: Efficient Inference with Adaptive Parallel Decoding and Sequential Knowledge Enhancement
records.reason: Cerberus adaptively selects parallel decoding per step and adds sequential knowledge while retaining parallel execution; abstract reports up to 2.12x speedup over autoregressive decoding.

records.title: MXFFP: Microscaling Flexible Floating Point Format for Large-Scale AI Model Acceleration
records.reason: Official IEEE abstract introduces flexible microscaling exponent/mantissa layouts and Tensor Core execution for large AI models; it explicitly evaluates LLM inference accuracy and maintains hardware performance comparable to MXFP.

records.title: Memory-Efficient Chunked Tropical Attention for Long Sequences
records.reason: source-unavailable borderline: DOI and candidate title are stable, but the official IEEE DOI/Xplore page returned “URL https://doi.org/10.1109/CAIBDA70336.2026.11621553 is not accessible via this tool.” Only secondary metadata/abstract results were discoverable and were not used for classification.

records.title: KVCMAS: Efficient KV cache Correction for Shared Context in Multi-Agent Systems
records.reason: KVCMAS uses compact low-rank online KV-cache correction across agents sharing context; abstract reports lower TTFT and reduced peak GPU memory under concurrent serving.

records.title: A rigor-matched audit of periodic-step layer skipping for efficient llm inference: conflayers versus swift, with a supplemental analysis of trained routing alternatives
records.reason: The primary abstract audits inference-time layer skipping and self-speculative decoding under matched protocols, quantifying actual speedups and overhead; directly relevant to inference efficiency evaluation.

records.title: Recurrent Residual Quantization: A Progressive Multi-Precision Representation for LLMs
records.reason: RRQ provides multiple effective LLM weight precisions from one checkpoint using a low-bit base and residuals; abstract compares construction time and accuracy across bit widths, relevant to memory/throughput deployment tradeoffs.

records.title: Semantic Retention and Extreme Compression in LLMs: Can We Have Both?
records.reason: The primary abstract evaluates joint LLM pruning and quantization against compression/semantic-retention tradeoffs, a direct model compression and deployment-efficiency topic.

records.title: Test-Time Speculation
records.reason: Test-Time Speculation adapts a draft model online using target verification signals to sustain speculative-decoding acceptance length on long generations; primary abstract reports gains over existing speculators.

records.title: HybridServe: Stall-Free Distributed Disaggregated LLM Inference with Hybrid KVCache Buffering
records.reason: Official CLOSER/INSTICC abstract describes disaggregated LLM inference and HybridServe CPU-memory KV buffering to reduce stalls and inter-node latency; it reports TTFT and throughput improvement.
